sentences.text: Shri Madhur Shukla - Advocate for the respondent/EOW.

Order 
This is the fourth application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS) for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.43/2021 registered at Police Station EOW, District Rewa, for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 468, 471 and 120-B of the Indian Penal Code.

The applicant is in jail since 16.01.2022.
2.

In pursuance of order passed by this Court on 11.02.2025, status report of trial has been received revealing the fact that only three witnesses, who are the government officers, are yet to be recorded.

Under such circumstances, I am disposing of this application directing the trial Court concerned to expedite the trial and make all possible efforts to conclude it within a period of three months from today.

However, if the remaining witnesses are not coming forward for NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:12312 2 MCRC-50111-2024 recording their statement, then the trial Court is at liberty to adopt coercive methods for securing their presence before it.
3. With the aforesaid, the application stands disposed of.
4. However, the applicant is at liberty to revive their prayer of bail after a period of three months.
